name: lupa-ai
description: Generate images and videos, upscale images and videos, render new camera angles, create 3D models of objects and make real-estate videos from photos with Lupa AI.

interface.longDescription:
Lupa AI brings image and video generation into ChatGPT. Describe what you want and Lupa AI creates it with the same models you use on lupa.art.

What you can do:
- Generate images from a text prompt, with a chosen aspect ratio and optional reference images.
- Generate short videos from a prompt or from an image.
- Upscale images to 4K or 8K, including skin retouching and old photo restoration.
- Upscale videos.
- Render a subject from new camera angles.
- Turn photos of an object into a 3D model and download it as GLB, USDZ, OBJ, STL or SKP.
- Make real-estate and interior videos from photos of a space (Space Motion and Video Presets).

Results appear in the conversation when they are ready and are saved to your Lupa AI workspace.

Who it is for: designers, marketers, architects, interior designers, real-estate agents, photographers and creators who work with images and video.

Limitations: you need a Lupa AI account, and Lupa AI works within the workspace you connect. Content that breaks Lupa AI's usage policy (for example sexual content or real-person deepfakes) is refused. Account settings are managed at lupa.art.

Make a 5-second video of waves hitting a cliff at sunset

positive.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with an aspect ratio
positive.prompt: Generate a photo of a golden retriever wearing sunglasses on a beach, 16:9
positive.expected_behavior: A 16:9 image of a golden retriever wearing sunglasses on a beach appears inline in a Lupa AI result card, usually within about 30 seconds.

positive.description: Generate a short video from a text prompt
positive.prompt: Make a 5-second video of waves hitting a cliff at sunset
positive.expected_behavior: A Lupa AI card shows the video as generating and then plays the finished 5-second clip of waves at sunset, typically within a few minutes.

positive.description: Generate an image and then upscale it (chained request)
positive.prompt: Generate a modern living room with large windows, then upscale it to 4K
positive.expected_behavior: The living room image is generated first; the upscale then runs on that image and the 4K result appears inline in its own card.

positive.description: New camera angles of a generated subject
positive.prompt: Generate a red sneaker on a white background, then show it from three other angles
positive.expected_behavior: Lupa generates the red sneaker, then returns the 8 preset camera angles of the same sneaker in one card (lupa_generate_camera_angles renders either one chosen angle or all 8 presets in a single call). The original and the new views appear inline.

positive.description: Check credits and estimate a cost before generating
positive.prompt: How many Lupa credits do I have left, and how much would a 5-second video cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connected workspace's remaining credit balance and the credit cost of a 5-second video, without starting a generation.

negative.description: Informational question about resolution, sent without @mentioning the plugin: ChatGPT answers it directly and does not call Lupa or start an upscale
negative.prompt: What's the difference between 4K and 8K when printing a photo?

negative.description: Billing actions are not supported from ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Buy 1000 more Lupa credits with my card

negative.description: Account deletion is not supported from ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Delete my Lupa AI account and all my images

review.commerce_description: Lupa AI does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Generations spend credits from the user's existing Lupa AI plan; plans and credits are purchased on lupa.art.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: tool names now describe each action (for example lupa_generate_camera_angles, lupa_get_download_link, lupa_check_connection), tool descriptions are rewritten to state what each tool does and when to use it, and tools no longer request analytics fields. The listing now covers 3D models and real-estate videos, which the server already offered.
